summary: break stops a loop early and continue skips to the next pass. Use them when you are searching for something or need to skip bad data.
notes: continue jumps back to the top of the loop. The print(f"Passing: ...") line is skipped for -1.
break leaves the loop completely, so 75 is never checked.
The else on a for loop runs only when the loop ends without break. It lines up with for, not with if.
pitfall: Indenting else under the if instead of under the for turns it into a normal if/else, so it runs on every pass where the score passes.
